title: Set Matrix Zeroes
statement: If an element is 0, set its entire row and column to 0. Do it in place in the algorithm and return the matrix. Use constant extra memory besides the matrix.
hints: A copy of the zero positions is the easy solution and uses extra memory.
Use the first row and first column as markers. Remember separately whether those two lines themselves must be zeroed.
Write markers first, then zero the inner cells, then zero the first row and column if their flags say so.

approaches.name: First row and column as markers

editorial: Scan the matrix. If matrix[r][c] is 0, set matrix[r][0] and matrix[0][c] to 0. Also record whether row 0 or column 0 originally contained a zero, because those cells are now doing double duty. A second scan, from the bottom-right of the inner matrix, zeroes a cell when its marker row or marker column is zero. Apply the two flags last.

examples.explanation: The middle row and column become zero.
Both marked rows and columns are cleared.
